problem: In a nondegenerate triangle, every pair of side lengths has a sum greater than the remaining side length.

proof_idea.original: Extend one side by the other side, use isosceles angles and the larger-angle/larger-side theorem, then identify the total extended length.
proof_idea.analytic: Strict Gram bound gives sqrt(x)+sqrt(y)>sqrt(z); consume the actual positive segment-length function and triangle vertex permutations for all three sums.

litex_code:
# Book I.20: each pair of actual triangle side lengths exceeds the remaining length.
thm proposition_20:
    ? forall a, b, c cart(R, R):
        a != b
        a != c
        b != c
        $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        =>:
            segment_length(a, b) + segment_length(a, c) > segment_length(b, c)
            segment_length(a, b) + segment_length(b, c) > segment_length(a, c)
            segment_length(a, c) + segment_length(b, c) > segment_length(a, b)
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    release thm geometry::main::triangle_det_squared_vertex(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 > 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(b, a, c)
    release thm cyclic_triangle_determinant(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(c, a), geometry::main::vec(c, b)) != 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(c, a, b)
    release thm adjacent_triangle_lengths_exceed_opposite(a, b, c)
    release thm adjacent_triangle_lengths_exceed_opposite(b, a, c)
    release thm adjacent_triangle_lengths_exceed_opposite(c, a, b)
    release thm segment_length_is_symmetric(a, b)
    release thm segment_length_is_symmetric(a, c)
    release thm segment_length_is_symmetric(b, c)
    segment_length(a, b) + segment_length(b, c) = segment_length(b, a) + segment_length(b, c) > segment_length(a, c)
    segment_length(a, c) + segment_length(b, c) = segment_length(c, a) + segment_length(c, b) > segment_length(a, b)
